elements.name: sprout launches the full graphics pipeline

steps.name: the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Starting full pipeline (graphics + input)" within 60s
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Spawned bristle" within 60s
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Spawned bloom" within 120s
the serial output should contain "bloom: compositor service starting" within 120s
the serial output should contain "bloom: service loop started" within 180s
the serial output should contain "First frame rendered" within 180s
